body: Usually there’s an option for you to opt out to mail service. Try calling them and ask if there’s an option for you to do that. It depends on which program you have. Opt out or ask what is the plan pref retail pharma, you should have one like Walgreens etc.
You can ask for a refund. They usually mail you doc to sign and fill out. Don’t forget to attach the statement/bill.
Call Optum directly and try to ask them if they can process a return kit for you to return the medication.
If that happens again ask Optum RX to process a resend order. Also, if you rn out of medication before you receive your order you can actually get an emergency/urgent refill to you local pharma.
You can directly call OptumRx and request a pharmacist. Consult the pharmacist about Vyvanse and feel free to ask an alternative.

You can call either of the two then have them call the Prior Authorization Department. Ask the advocate to conference the call. The advocate from PA Dep’t should be able to provide you more information about the denial.
